title: Squadron safety survey turns up four more unreported near-midairs

tellings.quote: And as it turned out, there were like four other near midairs that our squadron had over the past, you know, few months with this issue that went unreported.

plain: After one near-collision in the air, a safety check in a Navy fighter squadron near Virginia Beach is said to have turned up four more near midair collisions with the same unexplained problem over the previous few months, none of which had been reported. The fighter pilot Ryan Graves, who flew with that squadron, tells Michels this himself. He links it to a hazard report, the Navy's formal safety report on a near-accident. If he is right, these close calls were far more common than the official record showed.
